text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 73 vials of etoposide 20 mg/mL, 25 mL. Current use is 3 vials per day, providing 24.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show etoposide is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. No public FDA signal has been issued for the plants supplying our current stock.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. No shortage exists per FDA records. The top-ranked purchasing option is AVYXA Pharma, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today. Its label does not name a plant we could place. Secondary options include Accord Healthcare Inc., BluePoint Laboratories, Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, and H2-Pharma, LLC, none of which are on FDA's shortage list today. Their labels also name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place a replenishment order with AVYXA Pharma, LLC; requires pharmacy director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Accord Healthcare Inc. as a secondary source; requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify BluePoint Laboratories as a tertiary source; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes to the committee; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or clinical protocol changes at this time.
